item.title: Google’s $12bn Marvell bet: what the chip supply shake-up means for data centre capital plans
item.summary: Marvell's equity-linked silicon deal with Google reshapes the custom chip market, and data centre operators and investors need to understand what it signals about power density, vendor risk and capex planning. The post Google’s $12bn Marvell bet: what the chip supply shake-up means for data centre capital plans appeared first on Capacity .
